summary.text: Full Stack Engineer focused on building production-ready applications with strong ownership from architecture to deployment. Experienced with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Redis, delivering end-to-end systems used by real users. Background includes Web3 integrations such as on-chain automation, token allowance flows, and wallet-based interactions. Experienced in AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery and improve code quality
